interactiveObjects.name: Artisan Supply Crate
interactiveObjects.description: An open wooden crate stocked with starter ingots, timber, and ember resin for proving recruits.

interactiveObjects.name: Ironbound Field Chest
interactiveObjects.description: A weather-beaten watchtower strongbox secured by a simple tumbler lock. Practice lockpicking here with Steel Lockpicks.

interactiveObjects.name: Fallen Boundary Pillar
interactiveObjects.description: A moss-covered stone pillar partially blocking the alcove beside the beacon stairs. Heave it aside with Athletics to uncover a tucked supply pouch.

transcript.speaker: Cliff Discovery
transcript.text: You brace your shoulder and roll the stone aside, uncovering a gleaming Emerald Wayfarer Amulet!
